info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Update Market Data By Param1-spec
info.description: The Market Data Update API allows for the modification of market data specific to a quant model identified by a parameter. This endpoint enables users to update relevant market data attributes dynamically, ensuring that financial analyses and decisions are based on the most current information. Financial analysts and data engineers typically utilize this API to enhance market models or adjust simulations in real-time. The API facilitates efficient data management in quant finance applications, supporting rapid adjustments and strategic insights.

patch.summary: Update the details of a specific quantitative model.
patch.description: This operation allows you to update the attributes and parameters of the specified quantitative model identified by RES-100045. Ensure that you provide the necessary details in the request body to successfully modify the model.
